newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Jan-Sept car sales off 36 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Jan-Sept car sales off 36 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Venezuela were down 36.14 percent in the first nine months of 1996 at 39,126 units compared to 61,266 units in the first nine months of 1995, the Venezuelan Automobile Chamber (CAVENEZ) said Monday.
Vehicle sales of 5,173 in September were also down 4.3 percent from 5,407 sold in August, the CAVENEZ figures showed.

Of the 5,173 vehicles sold in September, 450 were imported and the rest were assembled in Venezuela. In addition, Venezuela exported 961 vehicles in September, down 26 percent from 1,305 in September 1995.

General Motors Corp led the Venezuelan market with 27 percent of total sales in the first nine months. Ford Motor Co followed with 21 percent, Toyota Motor Corp with 18 percent and Fiat SpA with 14 percent.
